units: <cite ref="Bava Batra 11a:3">B. Bath. 11ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Peah 4:18">Tosef. Peah IV, 18</cite> <he>אבותיך גָּנְזוּ וכ׳</he> thy ancestors saved (treasures) and increased the savings of their fathers.
Ḥag. 12ᵃ למי גְּנָזוֹ for whom has He reserved it?; a. fr.—Part. pass. גָּנוּז, f. גְּנוּזָה reserved.

senses.gloss: to remove from sight, hide (in order to prevent desecration).
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 13:5">Tosef. Sabb. XIII</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 14:5">XIV</cite>), 5; <cite ref="Shabbat 116a">Sabb. 116ᵃ</cite>.
<cite ref="Megillah 26b">Meg. 26ᵇ</cite> a book of the Law in a state of decay <he>גּוֹנְזִין אותו וכ׳</he> is buried by the side of a scholar; a. fr.

senses.gloss: to declare a book apocryhal, to suppress, prohibit the reading of.
units: <cite ref="Pesachim 56a:2">Pes. 56ᵃ</cite> <he>ג׳ ספר רפואות</he> suppressed the Book of Remedies.

<cite ref="Shabbat 115a:7">Sabb. 115ᵃ</cite> <he>אף הוא צוה עליו וגְנָזוֹ</he> he (R. Gamliel junior), too, gave orders about it and suppressed it; <cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 13:3">Tosef. ib. XIII</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 14:3">XIV</cite>), 3; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Shabbat 30b:3">Sabb. 30ᵇ</cite> <he>בקשו חכמים לִגְנוֹז וכ׳</he> the scholars wanted to suppress (declare uncanonical) the Book of Koheleth; a. fr.

<cite ref="Yoma 52b:11">Yoma 52ᵇ</cite> <he>משנ׳ הארון נִגְנְזָה וכ׳</he> when the Holy Ark was removed, there disappeared with it &c.; <cite ref="Tosefta Yoma 3:7">Tosef. ib. III</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Yoma 2:7">II</cite>), 7.

<cite ref="Tosefta Sotah 2:2">Tosef. Sot. II, 2</cite> <he>מגילתה נִגְנֶזֶת וכ׳</he> the scroll used for the suspected wife (<cite ref="O00286"><he>סוטה</he></cite>) was hidden away under the door pivot of the Temple; a. fr.

<cite ref="Shabbat 13b:8">Sabb. 13ᵇ</cite> <he>אלמלא הוא נ׳ וכ׳</he> but for him, the Book of Ezekiel would have been suppressed; <cite ref="Chagigah 13a">Ḥag. 13ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Menachot 45a">Men. 45ᵃ</cite>; a. e.
